name: Varsen DigitForm Gusset Pant
description: Straight cargo pants in slate grey ripstop built with a dramatically extended gusset and extra fabric in the lower leg — designed to accommodate digitigrade aug legs, which sit differently in a pant than standard anatomy. The hem is cut long and wide with an internal cinch cord for custom fit. Compatible with most geneware digitigrade modifications as well. They sit high on the waist and are loose through the thigh.
functionality: Extended gusset and lower leg volume accommodate digitigrade aug and geneware leg profiles. Internal cinch cord allows hem adjustment for varied limb geometry.
what_it_says: Your body is non-standard and you found pants that actually fit.
worn_by: Tier 2 workers with non-standard leg geometry
story_hooks: These are one of the only off-the-shelf pants that fit a specific rare aug configuration — finding a pair in the right size is a minor quest.
A character wearing these stands out because their lower-leg silhouette is clearly non-standard; it tells anyone who looks what kind of chrome they're running.
